description: The massime of one Corte costituzionale decision, in massima-number order: numero, titolo, testo and the source link. Parameters: ecli (ECLI:IT:COST:<year>:<number>). An unknown decision and a decision without massime both give no rows (use pronuncia to tell them apart). Example: {"ecli": "ECLI:IT:COST:2017:180"}.
